headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 5 studies yielded an effect size of 1.16 (95% CI: 0.84–1.6), indicating no statistically significant association between alcohol and aggressive prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 74.36%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
